precepts.text: Set thou a wicked man over him: and let Satan stand at his right hand. That's Genesis 4:7; that's 2 Thessalonians 2 that we just read. He follows everything Satan says.
precepts.point: Even him, whose coming is after the working of Satan: our comings is supposed to be after Christ the Lord, but the white man's comings and goings is after Satan. That goes back to Genesis 4.

note.label: Drowning in Sin & Perdition

precepts.why:
“Set thou a wicked man over him: and let Satan stand at his right hand.” That is Genesis 4:7, where Satan was set to rule over Cain, and it is 2 Thessalonians 2, the Wicked “whose coming is after the working of Satan.”

The wicked man has Satan standing at his right hand, and he follows everything Satan says. That is why his coming is with “all power and signs and lying wonders”: it is Satan's working carried out through the man he rules.

So the scriptures line up from the beginning to the end: Cain under Satan's rule, the Pharisees doing the lusts of their father the devil, and the man of sin coming after the working of Satan, until the Lord consumes him with the spirit of his mouth.

precepts.text: Set thou a wicked man over him and let Satan stand at his right hand; let his prayer become sin, his days be few and another take his office: the lot of those who revile the hoary head and rise against leadership, as in 2018.
precepts.point: For one morsel of meat he sold his birthright: your trinkets are a morsel of meat, and afterward Esau was rejected and found no place of repentance though he sought it with tears. That will be many bitter brothers and sisters in that day, and Christ will say I never knew thee.

note.label: Eleutherophobia the Fear of Freedom

precepts.why:
Hebrews says “Lest there be any fornicator, or profane person, as Esau”. Paul is comparing the wicked of our people to Esau, who was wicked and estranged from the womb and went to the Canaanitish women when he wanted to get married. The bitter among us become compared to Edom, and Satan becomes their daddy. Psalms shows it: “Set thou a wicked man over him: and let Satan stand at his right hand.” That wicked man is Satan, the daddy of Esau and of the wicked of our people.

“When he shall be judged, let him be condemned: and let his prayer become sin.” Why does his prayer become sin? Because Christ said if you have an ought with your brother, go to him; leave your gift at the altar. You can't come to the Lord while the matter between you and your brother and your sister is not dealt with right. In 2018 there were extortioners speaking against leadership. You are not supposed to rise up against the hoary head; you are supposed to honor, and not revile the gods, your leaders. There was a lot of disrespect and dishonor.

“Let his days be few; and let another take his office. Let his children be fatherless, and his wife a widow.” That is what happens when Satan becomes your daddy. Repent.

So the profane spirit of Hebrews 12, the bitter brother or sister who turns on leadership, carries this lot. We are trying to encourage our people not to be worldly, not to keep the customs of Edom and the I-do-me, but to come back home to your people.

precepts.text: Let them be before the Lord continually, that he may cut off the memory of them from the earth.
precepts.point: The gin shall take him by the heel, terrors shall make him afraid on every side, the missiles, and the firstborn of death shall devour his strength; Acts 26:23 says Christ is the first that should rise from the dead. He is brought to the king of terrors, brimstone is scattered on his habitation, his branch, his children, is cut off, his remembrance perishes from the earth, and he is driven from light into darkness and chased out of the world. Knowing Esau will be like a bad dream. Such are the dwellings of the wicked, him that knoweth not God.

note.label: There Is No Hate Like Christian Love

precepts.why:
“His remembrance shall perish from the earth, and he shall have no name in the street.” Your slave master, the one who taught you about this Bible, shall perish from the earth. David says it too: “Let them be before the Lord continually, that he may cut off the memory of them from the earth.” God said their memory will be cut off.

“He shall be driven from light into darkness, and chased out of the world.” There is going to come a time when knowing about Esau will be like a bad dream: man, I had a dream I was in slavery to the basest people on planet earth.

“He shall neither have son nor nephew among his people, nor any remaining in his dwellings.” Cut off totally; a time is coming when they will not be around any more. “Surely such are the dwellings of the wicked, and this is the place of him that knoweth not God.” This ain't talking about our people; it is talking about Esau, the wicked on the earth. Destruction is coming to him, and even his memory will be cut off.

precepts.text: All our enemies have opened their mouths against us, and these enemies are the nations.
precepts.point: They compassed me about also with words of hatred and fought against me without a cause. For my love they are my adversaries, but I give myself unto prayer. We have to give ourselves unto prayer and let God fight our battles, for it is not by our might.

note.label: Psalm 109: Give Myself unto Prayer

precepts.why:
“For the mouth of the wicked and the mouth of the deceitful are opened against me: they have spoken against me with a lying tongue.” Jeremiah says the same in the captivity: “All our enemies have opened their mouths against us.”

The people speaking against us with a lying tongue are the nations. They are the enemies whose mouths are opened against us, compassing us about with words of hatred and fighting against us without a cause.

precepts.point: They compassed me about also with words of hatred and fought against me without a cause. For my love they are my adversaries, but I give myself unto prayer. We have to give ourselves unto prayer and let God fight our battles, for it is not by our might.

note.label: Psalm 109: Give Myself unto Prayer

precepts.why:
“For my love they are my adversaries: but I give myself unto prayer.” Luke 18 is where Christ shows what giving yourself unto prayer looks like.

When the nations compass us about with words of hatred and fight against us without a cause, we have to give ourselves unto prayer and let God fight our battles, for it is not by our might.

precepts.text: What shall one answer the messengers of the nation? That the Lord hath founded Zion, and the poor of His people, the Israelites, shall trust in it.
precepts.point: Let this be the reward of my adversaries from the Lord, and of them that speak evil against my soul. The adversaries are the nations, and the Lord fights for us against our enemies to save us.

note.label: Psalm 109: Give Myself unto Prayer

precepts.why:
“Because that he remembered not to shew mercy, but persecuted the poor and needy man”. The poor and needy man is Israel. “What shall one then answer the messengers of the nation? That the Lord hath founded Zion, and the poor of his people shall trust in it.”

The poor of his people, the Israelites, trust in Zion which the Lord has founded. The enemies showed us no mercy in captivity and continued to destroy us even when our iniquity came to an end; that is the answer to the messengers of the nation.

precepts.text: I delight to do thy will, O my God; if you are doing God's will you will do the laws of God.
precepts.point: Let this be the reward of my adversaries from the Lord, and of them that speak evil against my soul. The adversaries are the nations, and the Lord fights for us against our enemies to save us.

note.label: Psalm 109: Give Myself unto Prayer

precepts.why:
“As he loved cursing, so let it come unto him: as he delighted not in blessing, so let it be far from him.” Set against that is David: “I delight to do thy will, O my God: yea, thy law is within my heart.”

If you are doing God's will you will do the laws of God. The one who delights not in blessing but loves cursing is the nations doing their own will against the Israelites, afflicting the poor.

precepts.text: Be mindful of the Lord all your days and let not your will be set to sin or transgress His commandments; if you are not doing God's will you are doing your own will, as the nations do.
precepts.point: Let this be the reward of my adversaries from the Lord, and of them that speak evil against my soul. The adversaries are the nations, and the Lord fights for us against our enemies to save us.

note.label: Psalm 109: Give Myself unto Prayer

precepts.why:
“My son, be mindful of the Lord our God all thy days, and let not thy will be set to sin, or to transgress his commandments: do uprightly all thy life long, and follow not the ways of unrighteousness.”

There are only two wills. If you are not doing God's will, keeping his commandments, you are doing your own will, as the nations do. That is the one in the psalm who “clothed himself with cursing like as with his garment”: his will is set to sin, and so the cursing comes into his bowels like water.

precepts.text: The Lord your God goes with you to fight for you against your enemies to save you.
precepts.point: Let this be the reward of my adversaries from the Lord, and of them that speak evil against my soul. The adversaries are the nations, and the Lord fights for us against our enemies to save us.

note.label: Psalm 109: Give Myself unto Prayer

precepts.why:
“Let this be the reward of mine adversaries from the Lord, and of them that speak evil against my soul.” The reward comes from the Lord, because the Lord fights for us: “For the Lord your God is he that goeth with you, to fight for you against your enemies, to save you.”

The adversaries are the nations, and the Lord goes with us to fight against them, to save us.

precepts.text: The Lord shall go forth and fight against those nations, the enemies He fights against.
precepts.point: Let this be the reward of my adversaries from the Lord, and of them that speak evil against my soul. The adversaries are the nations, and the Lord fights for us against our enemies to save us.

note.label: Psalm 109: Give Myself unto Prayer

precepts.why:
“Then shall the Lord go forth, and fight against those nations, as when he fought in the day of battle.” Those nations are the adversaries of the psalm, the enemies he fights against.

The reward David asks for his adversaries from the Lord is the Lord himself going forth against the nations, as he fought in the day of battle, to save his people.

precepts.text: Not by might, nor by power, but by My Spirit, saith the Lord of hosts; these things, the destroying of the nations, will be by the Lord's Spirit.
precepts.point: I will greatly praise the Lord with my mouth and praise Him among the multitude, for He shall stand at the right hand of the poor, the Israelites, to save him from those that condemn his soul. He saves the poor by His commandments; keeping God's commandments and enduring in this truth is how we will be saved.

note.label: Psalm 109: Give Myself unto Prayer

precepts.why:
“That they may know that this is thy hand; that thou, Lord, hast done it.” The adversaries will know it was the Lord, because “Not by might, nor by power, but by my spirit, saith the Lord of hosts.”

These things, the destroying of the nations, will be by the Lord's Spirit, not by our might or power. That is how they will know that this is his hand and that he has done it.

precepts.text: The nations thought evil against us, but God meant it unto good, to bring to pass as it is this day to save much people alive.
precepts.point: I will greatly praise the Lord with my mouth and praise Him among the multitude, for He shall stand at the right hand of the poor, the Israelites, to save him from those that condemn his soul. He saves the poor by His commandments; keeping God's commandments and enduring in this truth is how we will be saved.

note.label: Psalm 109: Give Myself unto Prayer

precepts.why:
“Let them curse, but bless thou: when they arise, let them be ashamed; but let thy servant rejoice.” Joseph said it to his brothers: “as for you, ye thought evil against me; but God meant it unto good, to bring to pass, as it is this day, to save much people alive.”

The nations meant evil against us, but God means it for good, to bring to pass as it is this day, to save much people alive. So the adversaries are clothed with shame and covered with their own confusion, and the servant rejoices. He stands at the right hand of the poor, the Israelites, and saves them by his commandments; keeping God's commandments and enduring in this truth is how we will be saved.

note.label: Job The Black Prophet And Our People Today

This is what God told Cain: “If thou doest well, shalt thou not be accepted?” If you do well, meaning keep God’s law, won’t you be accepted of me? “And if thou doest not well”: if you choose to be rebellious, Cain, if you blacks choose to be rebellious, “sin lieth at the door.” Sin lies at your door. “And unto thee shall be his desire”: all his desires are gonna be unto Satan.

note.label: Job The Black Prophet And Our People Today

precepts.why: Here’s the precept to Satan standing at his right hand: “Even him, whose coming is after the working of Satan with all power and signs and lying wonders.”

note.label: Job The Black Prophet And Our People Today

precepts.why: Jump down to verse 12. This verse is talking about our people: “That they all might be damned who believed not the truth, but had pleasure in unrighteousness.” We’re gonna get the same judgment. You’re not going to just say all the white man’s the devil while you’re breaking commandments and attacking God’s people. You’re gonna get the same judgment.

note.label: Unlocking The Three Angels Prophecies And More

precepts.why: “And the whole multitude of them arose, and led him unto Pilate. And they began to accuse him, saying, We found this fellow perverting the nation, and forbidding to give tribute to Cesar, saying that he himself is Christ a King.” That is the mouth of the wicked and the deceitful opened against him, speaking with a lying tongue: they said Christ was perverting the nation.

note.label: Unlocking The Three Angels Prophecies And More

note.label: Unlocking The Three Angels Prophecies And More

precepts.why: “Jesus answered them, Many good works have I shewed you from my Father; for which of those works do ye stone me? The Jews answered him, saying, For a good work we stone thee not; but for blasphemy; and because that thou, being a man, makest thyself God.” They fought against him without a cause: they wanted to stone Christ.

note.label: Unlocking The Three Angels Prophecies And More

precepts.why:
“And ought not this woman, being a daughter of Abraham, whom Satan hath bound, lo, these eighteen years, be loosed from this bond on the sabbath day?” She couldn’t even stand up straight; she was bound.

“And when he had said these things, all his adversaries were ashamed: and all the people rejoiced for all the glorious things that were done by him.” It calls them his adversaries, and they were his own people. For his love they were his adversaries.

note.label: Unlocking The Three Angels Prophecies And More

precepts.why: “But his citizens hated him”: the citizens of Jerusalem hated the son of God, “and sent a message after him, saying, We will not have this man to reign over us.” The wicked scribes and Pharisees, the leadership, did not want Christ to rule over them.

note.label: Unlocking The Three Angels Prophecies And More

precepts.why: “Then the band and the captain and officers of the Jews took Jesus, and bound him”. They bound him with wire, with cords, with rope. That is evil for good.

note.label: Unlocking The Three Angels Prophecies And More

precepts.why: “But they cried out, Away with him, away with him, crucify him. Pilate saith unto them, Shall I crucify your King? The chief priests answered, We have no king but Cesar.” We have no king but the white man: that’s what they said. Today we call it a president; Caesar is a president. Caesar is also pronounced Kaiser, Khazar: it’s the same word.

note.label: Unlocking The Three Angels Prophecies And More

precepts.why: Go back to what was just read: “But they cried out, Away with him, away with him, crucify him. Pilate saith unto them, Shall I crucify your King? The chief priests answered, We have no king but Cesar.” We wanted the white man over us. And the Bible says, “Set thou a wicked man over him: and let Satan stand at his right hand.”

note.label: Unlocking The Three Angels Prophecies And More

precepts.why: “The same day there came certain of the Pharisees, saying unto him, Get thee out, and depart hence: for Herod will kill thee.” They were so concerned with Herod; they were enamored with Herod.

note.label: Unlocking The Three Angels Prophecies And More

precepts.why: “Then gathered the chief priests and the Pharisees a council, and said, What do we? for this man doeth many miracles. If we let him thus alone, all men will believe on him: and the Romans shall come and take away both our place and nation.” We were so in fear of Rome and in love with Rome: we both feared them and loved them at the same time. And that’s how it is with our people today.

note.label: Unlocking The Three Angels Prophecies And More

precepts.why:
This is the mystery behind Satan standing at his right hand. “And the Lord said unto Cain, Why art thou wroth?” What you mad for, Cain? Why you upset? “And why is thy countenance fallen?” Why your face look all sad and depressed like that?

“If thou doest well”, meaning if you are obedient to what I command, “shalt thou not be accepted? and if thou doest not well”, if you don’t do the commandments I’ve given, “sin lieth at the door. And unto thee shall be his desire”: Cain’s desire would be to Satan. Just as God told Eve her desire would be to her husband, anything Cain desired, knowledge, wisdom, understanding, rulership, he’d have to get from Satan. “And thou shalt rule over him”: thou, Satan, shall rule over him. Just like God said to the man, you shall rule over her, Satan rules over Cain. And this is before the flood. This Cain became the white man.

“And Cain talked with Abel his brother: and it came to pass, when they were in the field, that Cain rose up against Abel his brother, and slew him.” He killed his brother. They all looked the same at this time. “And the Lord said unto Cain, Where is Abel thy brother? And he said, I know not: Am I my brother’s keeper?” Remember the two great commandments in Matthew 22: they start out in the Bible right here.

“And he said, What hast thou done? the voice of thy brother’s blood crieth unto me from the ground.” Abel was alive in the spirit realm; that’s why his voice was crying unto the Lord.

“And now art thou cursed from the earth, which hath opened her mouth to receive thy brother’s blood from thy hand”. Adam was made of the dust of the ground, a black man made of the soil. Cain was cursed from the earth: his melanin left him and he started to change. The Most High said, I made you from it, and you’re cursed from it.

note.label: Unlocking The Three Angels Prophecies And More

precepts.why:
“Unto the woman he said, I will greatly multiply thy sorrow”, because our sisters, our women, our wife was rebellious; Eve was rebellious. “And thy conception”: so they would have childbearing pains, menstrual cramps. “In sorrow thou shalt bring forth children; and thy desire shall be to thy husband”. If you desire sex, knowledge or wisdom, you must get it from your husband: anything you desire, God said to Eve, get it from your man.

That explains Genesis 4:7. The same wording is said to Cain, “unto thee shall be his desire, and thou shalt rule over him”: as the man rules over the woman, Satan rules over Cain, and anything Cain desires he gets from Satan.

note.label: Unlocking The Three Angels Prophecies And More

precepts.why: “And the Lord God formed man of the dust of the ground”. So Adam was a black man, made of the soil, made of the earth. Then Cain is “cursed from the earth”: his melanin left him. He was made from the earth and cursed from it.

note.label: Unlocking The Three Angels Prophecies And More

precepts.why:
“Even him, whose coming is after the working of Satan with all power and signs and lying wonders”. He follows Satan; Satan rules him. Satan is ruling over this man of sin, and this is the same curse from Genesis 4:7, “unto thee shall be his desire, and thou shalt rule over him.”

Where do you think this man got his technology from? Satan. He desired knowledge, he desired wisdom, and he got all that: how to create an atom bomb, how to create chemical bombs, how to destroy the earth. Satan said, I got you.

note.label: Unlocking The Three Angels Prophecies And More

precepts.why:
“In this the children of God are manifest, and the children of the devil”. So God has children on the earth, and Satan got kids on earth too. The church ain’t figured that out yet; they’re looking around the sky. “Whosoever doeth not righteousness is not of God”: whosoever does not keep the commandments is not of God, “neither he that loveth not his brother.”

This is why it’s important for us to teach love thy neighbour as you love yourself to our people. Some at home are asking why that can’t be extended to the white man. It’s been over 500 years of us trying to talk to the white man, and it has not worked. A negro came out his mama’s behind yesterday talking about, why can’t we sit down and talk to the white man? Our ancestors had that same stupid thought back during slavery time. It didn’t work then, and it ain’t working now.

note.label: Unlocking The Three Angels Prophecies And More

precepts.why:
This is for the Christians online who think we can sit down at the table. Malcolm X said if we can sit down with the white man at a table and talk man to man, honestly, maybe he’ll listen. That’s not what God said.

“The wicked are estranged from the womb: they go astray as soon as they be born, speaking lies.” “Their poison is like the poison of a serpent”: their philosophies, their doctrines are like the poison of snakes. “They are like the deaf adder that stoppeth her ear”. You’re busy talking, and God says the white man is like a deaf snake that stops her ears. The adder ain’t got no ears. Look at the snake: it ain’t got no ears, and you’re trying to reason with him.

“Which will not hearken to the voice of charmers, charming never so wisely.” You black Christians are the charmers. Charming never so wisely means you come with all your wisdom, historic evidence and proof of why we deserve reparations, why we deserve justice, and the white man looks at you with that fake smile like, what is this? We have some of the most eloquent, intellectual speakers in the black community: Malcolm X was one of the best, and it didn’t work on the white man. You got your Umar Johnsons out there, bringing out evidence, bam, bam, bam. Nothing works on the white man.

God has one solution for the white man: “Break their teeth, O God, in their mouth: break out the great teeth of the young lions, O Lord.” That’s God’s solution: God the Lord is going to do that thing.

note.label: Unlocking The Three Angels Prophecies And More

precepts.why:
“Lest there be any fornicator, or profane person, as Esau, who for one morsel of meat sold his birthright.” This man sold his birthright.

“For ye know how that afterward, when he would have inherited the blessing, he was rejected”: God rejected this man. “For he found no place of repentance”: God says there’s no place of repentance for him. But what if he cries? “Though he sought it carefully with tears”: God didn’t care about it. That is “When he shall be judged, let him be condemned”.

note.label: Unlocking The Three Angels Prophecies And More

precepts.why: “He that turneth away his ear from hearing the law, even his prayer shall be abomination.” The white man turned his ear away from the law from the time of his birthright; he rejected everything God had for him. So his prayer becomes sin.

note.label: Unlocking The Three Angels Prophecies And More

precepts.why: “For Esau is the end of the world, and Jacob is the beginning of it that followeth.” Let his days be few and let another take his office: we got next.

note.label: Unlocking The Three Angels Prophecies And More

precepts.why: It all goes back to the beginning. “When thou tillest the ground, it shall not henceforth yield unto thee her strength; a fugitive and a vagabond shalt thou be in the earth.” A vagabond: a bum. That’s some heavy stuff right there. No getting out, you white man.

note.label: Unlocking The Three Angels Prophecies And More

precepts.why:
“The inheritance of sinners’ children shall perish”. This is the man that steals lands and property, homes and houses, and then passes it down to his children. “And their posterity shall have a perpetual reproach”: they’re always going to have a reproach.

“The children will complain of an ungodly father”: it wasn’t me, it was my forefathers; we didn’t enslave you, it was my fathers. “Because they shall be reproached for his sake.” We all say it to them today, and they say it wasn’t me, it was my father, I just benefit from it. Yeah, you. That’s what’s going on now: no accountability, zero responsibility, and an enormous amount of self-entitlement.

note.label: Unlocking The Three Angels Prophecies And More

precepts.why: “His children shall seek to please the poor”. We’re the poor. “And his hands shall restore their goods.” Everybody talks about reparations. God said don’t worry: we’re going to get our just reparations, because everything that they stole and passed down to their kids is going to be handed over to us.

note.label: Unlocking The Three Angels Prophecies And More

precepts.why:
“That which he laboured for shall he restore, and shall not swallow it down”: he ain’t going to enjoy it. “According to his substance shall the restitution be”: according to all that he has robbed and stolen. Restitution means reparations. “And he shall not rejoice therein”: that’s why he ain’t going to be happy in this thing.

“Because he hath oppressed and hath forsaken the poor”: we’re the poor. “Because he hath violently taken away an house which he builded not”. He violently took away everything he got. We built it and he stole it.

note.label: Unlocking The Three Angels Prophecies And More

precepts.why:
“Every one that is found shall be thrust through”: every Edomite in Babylon, throughout the world, that is found. “And every one that is joined unto them shall fall by the sword”: any of our people, any of the other nations joined to Esau.

“Their children also shall be dashed to pieces before their eyes”: that’s let none show favour to their children. “Their houses shall be spoiled, and their wives ravished.” That’s what the nations are going to do to them.

“Behold, I will stir up the Medes against them”: the Medes here is Iran. Write that down. “Which shall not regard silver; and as for gold, they shall not delight in it”: Iran doesn’t care about money and has no delight in silver and gold; they got that already. “Their bows also shall dash the young men to pieces”: their bows are their missiles. Armageddon is coming, brothers. It will happen; thus saith the Lord. “And they shall have no pity on the fruit of the womb; their eye shall not spare children.”

“And Babylon, the glory of kingdoms”: the United States of America, the most glorious kingdom on earth right now. “The beauty of the Chaldees’ excellency, shall be as when God overthrew Sodom and Gomorrah.” God overthrew Sodom and Gomorrah with thermonuclear fire, and that’s how this place is going to go down. That’s Bible prophecy.

note.label: Unlocking The Three Angels Prophecies And More

precepts.why:
“Prepare slaughter for his children for the iniquity of their fathers”: that’s what God says. For the sins of their fathers: you do pay for what your fathers did, because you are your fathers, and it goes all the way back to Cain and Abel.

“That they do not rise, nor possess the land, nor fill the face of the world with cities.” They’ll never build another city. That’s what the Bible says. Don’t get mad at us, don’t hate the messenger: you’ve never heard what the Bible says, and now we’re bringing it out.

note.label: Unlocking The Three Angels Prophecies And More

precepts.why:
Christ said the righteous blood of Abel shall fall upon them, which shows it is absolutely correct that the iniquity goes all the way back to Abel. “That upon you may come all the righteous blood shed upon the earth, from the blood of righteous Abel unto the blood of Zacharias son of Barachias, whom ye slew between the temple and the altar.”

He’s talking to our people. He said, y’all are so wicked you ain’t following in the footsteps of Abel; you’re following the footsteps of Cain. Therefore the judgment for the blood shed on Abel will be paid on you. Because the Pharisees did the bidding of Rome: they wanted to please Herod and Caesar, and thought if they killed Christ and his disciples they would please them. That’s the same thing with some of our people in the Christian church today.

note.label: Unlocking The Three Angels Prophecies And More

precepts.why: “And the Lord said unto Moses, Write this for a memorial in a book”: write this for a memorial in the book, the Bible, “and rehearse it in the ears of Joshua: for I will utterly put out the remembrance of Amalek from under heaven.” Who’s Amalek? These so-called Jewish people. That is cutting off the memory of them from the earth.

note.label: Unlocking The Three Angels Prophecies And More

precepts.why: “And the house of Jacob shall be a fire, and the house of Joseph a flame, and the house of Esau for stubble, and they shall kindle in them, and devour them; and there shall not be any remaining of the house of Esau; for the Lord hath spoken it.” Who spoke that? The Lord spoke that thing, so we can’t change it. The Lord don’t care about our feelings: he said there’s going to be none remaining.

note.label: Unlocking The Three Angels Prophecies And More

precepts.why:
Somebody online is going, but you read about Amalek and Esau, and that’s two different groups. No: it’s the same race. “These were dukes of the sons of Esau: the sons of Eliphaz the firstborn son of Esau”, and among them “duke Amalek”. So Amalek was a grandson of Esau. It’s the same family.

The dukes were the elites of them: the rich, the smarter ones, the more clever, crafty, cunning and wealthy. The synagogue of Satan. Netanyahu is one of their dukes. And to show how deep the witchcraft goes, they ask you when the atrocities in Gaza started, and you jump to say October 7th. No: that over there didn’t start October 7th. That began in 1948.

A Caucasian, an Edomite, Michael Bradley, found out some history and wrote it down in Chosen People from the Caucasus. Poorly informed blacks think of the Jews as people of the book and look more favourably on them than on other Caucasians, not knowing the Jews of Europe played the same role in our enslavement, oppression and colonization as other Europeans. He writes that most of them are descendants of Russian steppe tribesmen converted to Judaism around 740 AD, the Khazars, a fact Jewish scholars admit; that Jews were well represented among the conquistadors who murdered and enslaved the Indians and were major participants in the transatlantic slave trade, the greatest human tragedy history knows; and that 95% of the Jews in the modern world are Ashkenazim, with no genetic or historical connection with Palestine, so their claim to a homeland there is absurd. The white man wrote this. The devil deceiveth the whole world, and that’s what this author is bringing out.

note.label: Unlocking The Three Angels Prophecies And More

precepts.why: To prove who the poor are. “What shall one then answer the messengers of the nation? That the Lord hath founded Zion, and the poor of his people shall trust in it.” The poor of his people of Zion. Now that we’ve established Zion is the poor, the poor and needy man of Psalms 109:16 is not referring to all nations on the planet.

note.label: Unlocking The Three Angels Prophecies And More

precepts.why:
“Sit thou silent, and get thee into darkness, O daughter of the Chaldeans: for thou shalt no more be called, The lady of kingdoms.” America is called the lady of kingdoms, the greatest kingdom on earth.

“I was wroth with my people”: God was mad with us. “I have polluted mine inheritance”: he allowed us to get polluted here in this land, this kingdom, “and given them into thine hand”: God gave us into the hands of the white man because of our sins. “Thou didst shew them no mercy”: this white man showed us no mercy. “Upon the ancient hast thou very heavily laid thy yoke.” Verse six says the same thing as Psalms 109:16: this man showed us no mercy but persecuted the poor and needy.

note.label: Unlocking The Three Angels Prophecies And More

precepts.why: “He healeth the broken in heart, and bindeth up their wounds.” We want to know who the broken in heart is, the ones the wicked man of Psalms 109:16 seeks to slay. Verse 12 shows who it’s talking about.

note.label: Unlocking The Three Angels Prophecies And More

precepts.why: “Praise the Lord, O Jerusalem; praise thy God, O Zion.” O Jerusalem: that’s our people. We’re Jerusalem; Jerusalem is a people before it’s a place. O Zion: that’s our people. So the broken in heart he heals, and the broken in heart the white man slays, are our people.

note.label: Unlocking The Three Angels Prophecies And More

precepts.why: “And he took up his parable, and said, Balak the king of Moab hath brought me from Aram, out of the mountains of the east, saying, Come, curse me Jacob, and come, defy Israel.” That curse is not profanity. That curse is a literal spell he was asking him to do. That is the cursing the white man loves in Psalms 109:17.

note.label: Unlocking The Three Angels Prophecies And More

precepts.why: “Surely there is no enchantment against Jacob”: when you keep the commandments, the spell breaks, “neither is there any divination against Israel”. We must keep the commandments; that is the solution. The only spell breaker is the word of God.

note.label: Unlocking The Three Angels Prophecies And More

precepts.why:
“For the sin of their mouth and the words of their lips let them even be taken in their pride: and for cursing and lying which they speak.” The cursing and the lies. These people lie to get world sympathy: Donald Trump suggesting Jews might secretly be committing antisemitic hate crimes on themselves; a New York man arrested for painting swastikas on his own home; an Israeli man indicted for threats to Jewish community centers; the Anti-Defamation League conveying false information and cyberstalking; an antisemitic hate crime at a Winnipeg cafe allegedly faked by the owners; a man who told police he was stabbed for being Jewish until his Apple Watch caught him in a lie; a false report of an antisemitic incident on a school bus; a London mayor helping the Israel lobby fake antisemitic attacks; a singer who admitted he lied about antisemitic incidents.

They always want to play victim and then say a black man did it, so they get world sympathy. This is all from newspapers; nothing conjured. Stop lying. Why you always lying?

note.label: Psalm 109: Give Myself unto Prayer

points: “Hold not thy peace, O God of my praise”: that’s what David prayed, and that’s what we pray too.

note.label: Job The Black Prophet And Our People Today

points: “For the mouth of the wicked and the mouth of the deceitful are opened against me.” Just as David said in this song, so do we say today. You got wicked like the ADL, the SPLC, the Canary Mission with their mouths open against us. Then you’ve got wicked of our own race, our own people, speaking against us, lying, saying we bring guns to reservations, we’re killing men, we’re killing women. “They have spoken against me with a lying tongue”: they speak against us with a lying tongue.

note.label: Job The Black Prophet And Our People Today

points: “They compassed me about also with words of hatred; and fought against me without a cause”: they fight against us for no reason. They start a fist fight: you can’t make this stuff up. Without a cause. Just because we get a crowd and you don’t, you want to physically fight us? Are you kidding me? How about repent and pray for the Holy Spirit, brother? How about keep God’s laws? It’s envy and jealousy.

We didn’t have to hurt nobody; we just subdued them. If we wanted to, we would have stomped him out. We didn’t stomp them out. Just hold them; don’t hurt the brother. That’s how we get down, because we’re not out there to harm our people. But if you bring it, we’re gonna bring the fire; we’re gonna hold you down.

note.label: Job The Black Prophet And Our People Today

points: “For my love they are my adversaries: but I give myself unto prayer.” Brothers, sisters, we give ourselves to prayer. We ask the Lord for mercy upon these wicked negro Israelite camps: be merciful upon them, O Father, they know not what they do.

note.label: Job The Black Prophet And Our People Today

points: “And they have rewarded me evil for good, and hatred for my love.”

note.label: Job The Black Prophet And Our People Today

points: “Set thou a wicked man over him: and let Satan stand at his right hand.” See what David is saying here: if they can’t repent, this is what’s going to happen. Satan is going to take over them one hundred percent, just as he did Cain. The white man is gonna roll with them.

note.label: Job The Black Prophet And Our People Today

points: “When he shall be judged, let him be condemned: and let his prayer become sin. Let his days be few; and let another take his office. Let his children be fatherless, and his wife a widow.” “Let his children be continually vagabonds, and beg”: bums. “Let his posterity be cut off; and in the generation following let their name be blotted out.”

note.label: Job The Black Prophet And Our People Today

points: “Let the iniquity of his fathers be remembered with the Lord; and let not the sin of his mother be blotted out.” See, the white woman ain’t gonna escape either.

note.label: Job The Black Prophet And Our People Today

points: “Let them be before the Lord continually, that he may cut off the memory of them from the earth”: cut off their memory from the earth.

note.label: Job The Black Prophet And Our People Today

points: “Because that he remembered not to shew mercy”: this man remembered not to show mercy, “but persecuted the poor and needy man”: he persecuted the 12 tribes of Israel; that’s the poor and needy man. “That he might even slay the broken in heart”: that’s Israel. We are the broken in heart.

note.label: Job The Black Prophet And Our People Today

points: “Hold not thy peace, O God of my praise; For the mouth of the wicked and the mouth of the deceitful are opened against me: they have spoken against me with a lying tongue.” David is prophesying in terms of Christ, but it also translates to us, and that shows as we keep going down the psalm.
The lying tongue is what they said in Luke 23: that Christ was perverting the nation. And his teachings were called heresy. Don’t they say that about us today? It’s the same thing going on.

note.label: Unlocking The Three Angels Prophecies And More

points: “They compassed me about also with words of hatred; and fought against me without a cause.” They wanted to stone Christ for his good works.

note.label: Unlocking The Three Angels Prophecies And More

points: “For my love they are my adversaries: but I give myself unto prayer.” For my love they are my enemies. And those adversaries were his own people.

note.label: Unlocking The Three Angels Prophecies And More

points: “And they have rewarded me evil for good, and hatred for my love.” Our people rewarded Christ evil for good and hatred for his love. These are scriptural examples of it.

note.label: Unlocking The Three Angels Prophecies And More

points: “Set thou a wicked man over him: and let Satan stand at his right hand.” There’s some dark stuff right there. It starts off talking about the wicked Israelites of our people who didn’t want Christ to reign over them. They said, “We have no king but Cesar”: we wanted the white man over us. And the Bible says here, set thou a wicked man over him, and let Satan stand at his right hand.
The mystery behind it goes back to Genesis 4: Satan ruling over Cain. After the flood, through Shem’s line you had Jacob and Esau, to sum it up, and Esau came out with no melanin.

Even back then the spiritual demon Satan was operating with Rome. How do you think Rome was able to conquer everybody? Rome was the most powerful kingdom on the planet earth at that time, and Satan was working with Rome just like he’s working with America. And our people, the scribes and Pharisees, loved Rome and feared Rome; they wanted Rome to be our king.
Satan has children on the earth, and the wicked man set over us is the children of the devil.

note.label: Unlocking The Three Angels Prophecies And More

points: “When he shall be judged, let him be condemned”. There’s no salvation, no forgiveness for him. He’s going to be in the kingdom, don’t misunderstand; he’ll be there, but he’s not going to enjoy it. I don’t know why you think you can oppress people, colonize people, enslave people, murder people, and think you’re going to get the kingdom of heaven on earth, you and your children. It makes no logical sense.
“And let his prayer become sin.” He turned his ear away from the law, so even his prayer is abomination.

note.label: Unlocking The Three Angels Prophecies And More

points: “Let his days be few; and let another take his office.” We got next, brothers. We’re going to take his office.

note.label: Unlocking The Three Angels Prophecies And More

points: “Let his children be fatherless, and his wife a widow.”

note.label: Unlocking The Three Angels Prophecies And More

points: “Let his children be continually vagabonds, and beg: let them seek their bread also out of their desolate places.” A vagabond is a bum, and it all goes back to the beginning, to the curse on Cain.

note.label: Unlocking The Three Angels Prophecies And More

points: “Let the extortioner catch all that he hath; and let the strangers spoil his labour.” Everything they stole and passed down to their kids is going to be handed over to us.

note.label: Unlocking The Three Angels Prophecies And More

points: “Let there be none to extend mercy unto him”: nobody’s going to extend mercy to this man. “Neither let there be any to favour his fatherless children.” Isaiah 13 is the precept for letting none show favour to his fatherless children.

note.label: Unlocking The Three Angels Prophecies And More

points: “Let his posterity be cut off; and in the generation following let their name be blotted out.” Their name shall be blotted out.

note.label: Unlocking The Three Angels Prophecies And More

points: “Let the iniquity of his fathers be remembered with the Lord; and let not the sin of his mother be blotted out.” You do pay for what your fathers did, because you are your fathers. It goes all the way back to Genesis: Cain killed his brother, and the law is whoso sheddeth man’s blood, by man shall his blood be shed. Cain was worried that everyone finding him would slay him, and Cain’s children is Esau today. Now it’s time for him to get his judgment: the Most High is going to bring that law all the way back and allow the nations to slay him.

note.label: Unlocking The Three Angels Prophecies And More

points: “Let them be before the Lord continually, that he may cut off the memory of them from the earth.” God said he’s going to cut off the memory of them from the earth. Get mad if you want; it’s what the Lord said.

note.label: Unlocking The Three Angels Prophecies And More

points: “Because that he remembered not to shew mercy”: this white man remembered not to show our people mercy, “but persecuted the poor and needy man”. Somebody right now is saying white people are poor and Chinese people are poor; that’s not who it’s talking about. The poor are Zion, our people, not all nations on the planet. “That he might even slay the broken in heart.” The broken in heart are Jerusalem and Zion: our people.

That’s what the Bible means when it says they showed us no mercy. They used to gather the tribe of Gad and Reuben and hang them up by thirteens, representing Christ and the apostles, and burn them alive with the fire under them, and take our babies and smash them on the rocks. They cut the people open to get the babies out, split them in two. They did it to the men too: took our entrails out and fed us to the dogs. These are drawings they did between 1492 and the 1500s. They cut the hands off if they didn’t bring back enough gold, and cut off the hands and noses. They impaled a family, the father on the left, the mother on the right and the baby in the middle, a spike through the rectum, and threw us into pits with spikes in them, pregnant and nursing women, children and old persons. Did they do the same thing in the Congo? Same thing, different dates, the same people.

They tied a little boy to a tree as gator bait to bring the gator on land, and sometimes they let the gator swallow the baby. They even put it on cans of licorice: our baby about to be eaten by an alligator was the logo. And Derby’s dose on the Jamaican plantations: beaten, salt pickle, lime juice and pepper rubbed into the wounds, another slave made to defecate in the victim’s mouth, and the mouth shut for hours. That’s what they did to us.

The churches will never illustrate what the Bible is talking about, but we will, because we’re the prophets of God. Bring it all the way up from slavery to today: the people in those pictures have children grown today, sitting as your judges and the teachers in your school, and you want to know why she treats your child so bad? She was taught that. Look at all the names of our people killed. And y’all want to sit down and seek justice from this man who has shown us no mercy from the time of slavery to today, while men and women on the street say go out and vote. If our people think they can sit down at the table and talk to this man, that ain’t going to work.

note.label: Unlocking The Three Angels Prophecies And More

points: “As he loved cursing, so let it come unto him: as he delighted not in blessing, so let it be far from him.” The first thought when you read about cursing is profanity, the hell with you. This is deeper than that: the cursing is a literal spell.

You ever ask yourself why there is so much hatred amongst our people? It’s as if a spell is on us. There is. Television, the internet, radio, the newsroom put messages out there that cause us to hate one another, hate our children, abort our children. That is a spell. You don’t see no other race doing it the way black men and black women and Latin men and Latin women do this. And the only spell breaker is the word of God.

Kamala Harris sat down with a rapper named Quavo and asked him his solutions for gun violence. Doesn’t he rap about evil, harming people? And you’re asking him for a solution? The only solution is us repenting as Israelites, keeping the commandments. There is no other way.
